product_metadata.title: SONGMICS Bamboo Entryway Shoe Shelf Storage Organizer, Ideal for Hallway Bathroom Garden, 4-tier, Ash Gray
features: MULTIFUNCTIONAL BAMBOO SHOE RACK: 100% natural bamboo, environment friendly and sturdy; 4 tiers bamboo rack & storage shelf for shoes, bags, plants, toiletries, baskets in entryway, bedroom, bathroom, balcony, closet, etc.
FOUR BREATHABLE SHELVES AND DIY AS YOU WISH: Four-tier slatted shelves make shoes breathing from the gaps, preventing any odor. You can remove a layer for high stuff
THOUGHTFUL WORKMANSHIP: Natural and smooth finish, rounded corners, protect your family from being scratched, especially the children
EASY ASSEMBLY AND DISASSEMBLY: Antirust and durable screws can be installed and disassembled repeatedly, tools provided. Two hollowed out handles for easy carrying
SPACE-SAVING SHOE RACK: Product size: 26. 6"L x 10. 3"W x 29. 4"H, slim figure to put in your cubby closet, wardrobe, cabinet, garage, entrance, foyer and other storage area
